description: Readable 16px+ clues/current words, 44px+ arrows and no overflow at 320/390/768/1440
Following marks only the selected column; keyboard wraps a row and navigates rows; undo restores letters without refunding the move
A check costs one; moving expires its feedback and undo reuses the same checked arrangement without another charge
Actual partial correctness expires and returns with its exact layout; correct columns never lock row controls
Nudge cancel is inert, approval spends exactly one move/hint but no check; undo and reload preserve assistance/counters
Nudges can align every row but never auto-win; explicit check completes an assisted result, not a perfect one
Double activation of the same confirmation cannot charge two nudges
A complete manual solve requires its first explicit check, reports perfection without an optimal-move claim, and preserves terminal state/focus
Real portrait/square PNG downloads contain factual date/check/move/nudge totals, with no answer words in the caption
Reopened share retains played date after midnight; mocked cancel keeps focus and denied clipboard selects manual copy
Revealed Practice remains explicit and separate from the saved Daily win
A real second-tab change with delayed storage events cancels a stale nudge at the write boundary without charging or claiming row correctness
Storage delivery between approval and its frame cancels the nudge against changed progress
No browser page errors
